headline: Türkiye's Gross External Debt Rises to $549.2 Billion in Third Quarter
summary: Data from Türkiye's central bank showed national gross external debt rose by $7.8 billion in Q3 to hit $549.2 billion, with private sector debt reaching $322.2 billion.
why: The Central Bank of the Republic of Türkiye compiles balance of payments and external liability statistics for the country.
